item.title: Tesla, Chint Power lead new long-duration storage leaderboard
item.description: Tesla and Chint Power rank first and second in a new long-duration energy storage leaderboard from Sightline Climate, while mechanical storage providers such as Italy’s Energy Dome feature prominently as post–final investment decision projects begin to reshape the competitive landscape.

item.title: Bulgaria installs 1.4 GW of solar in 2025
item.description: Bulgaria installed over 1 GW of solar for the third consecutive year in 2025 and is forecast to add over 2 GW this year thanks to a large pipeline of utility-scale projects.

item.title: Solar-plus-storage for data centers: not a simple switch
item.description: Renewables and storage could reliably power data centers, but success requires active grids, coordinated planning, and the right mix of technologies. Hitachi Energy CTO, Gerhard Salge, tells pv magazine that holistic approaches ensure technical feasibility, economic viability, and energy system resilience.

item.title: Silver price drops sharply, falls back below $80 an ounce
item.description: After hitting an all-time high of $121.65/oz on Jan. 29, silver prices have tumbled to $79.44/oz, with analysts warning of a potential drop toward $50/oz.

item.title: The impact of microclimate effects on floating PV plants
item.description: French researchers have developed a high-resolution computational framework to model microclimate effects of large floating solar PV systems, enabling accurate predictions of heat transfer, ambient temperatures, and water evaporation based on panel configuration and wind conditions. The model can inform thermal performance, environmental impacts, and optimize designs for utility-scale floating PV, as well as ground-mounted and agrivoltaic installations.

item.title: Europe contracts nearly 24 GWh of BESS under flexibility purchase agreements in 2025
item.description: With conventional renewable PPA momentum slowing, Europe’s flexibility market soared in 2025, driven by a surge in fixed-offtake agreements and BESS optimization structures. At the same time, co-located storage gained unprecedented traction, signaling a shift toward more integrated and flexible energy solutions.

item.title: Brazil curtails 20% of solar and wind output in 2025, with losses at $1.2 billion
item.description: Brazil curtailed about one-fifth of its solar and wind generation in 2025, wasting an estimated BRL 6.5 billion ($1.23 billion), as grid constraints and demand mismatches pushed the power system close to operational safety limits on 16 days, according to a report from Volt Robotics.

item.title: Data center survey reveals majority believe renewables and BESS are the ideal energy mix, power issues start in 2027
item.description: 54% of respondents cited “energy availability and redundancy” as the single greatest obstacle to successful data center development between now and 2030.

item.title: Key takeaways from Solar Flex Prague
item.description: Czechia’s first international conference on solar and flexibility highlighted that the combination of solar with storage and flexibility sources is key to not just Czechia’s, but also Europe’s, secure and competitive electricity system.

item.title: Spain deploys 1.13 GW of solar for self-consumption in 2025
item.description: Spain installed 1.14 GW of solar capacity for self-consumption in 2025, lifting cumulative capacity to 9.3 GW, as residential and commercial installations declined while industrial and off-grid segments showed greater resilience, according to data from the Spanish Photovoltaic Union.
